column_interpretation.column_1: Named time by contract; exact represented decimal values are inspected.
column_interpretation.column_2: Named strain by contract; exact represented decimal values are inspected.
column_interpretation.units_and_physics: Seconds, dimensionless strain, NR model identity, mass scaling and data-informed amplitude/phase are external publisher claims, not established by these numeric fields.

identity_boundary: Expected size and hash are caller-supplied acquisition claims, verified against the complete retained bytes before parsing. URL, redirects and publisher provenance are not independently verified by this program.

interpretation_boundary.comparison: No filter, overlay, fitted shift, sign change, normalization, residual score, significance or parameter recovery is performed.
interpretation_boundary.native_prediction: No DET forward law, withheld prediction or DET-versus-GR inference is supplied.
interpretation_boundary.numeric_representation: Fraction arithmetic preserves every decimal token exactly; no binary64 conversion or resampling is performed.
interpretation_boundary.support: No interpolation, extrapolation, waveform continuation or boundary condition is supplied.
interpretation_boundary.timing: Printed-time diagnostics establish no absolute arrival time, V1-to-V2 offset transfer, placement or clock calibration.

text_structure.blank_line_policy: Blank lines retained by one-based line number; no numeric row omitted.

candidate_grid.candidate_authority: Declared diagnostic, not inferred publisher provenance.

closed_half_last_place_diagnostic.hypothesis: Printed time i is within q_i/2 of a+i/4096, where q_i is its decimal last-place quantum.
closed_half_last_place_diagnostic.interpretation: Closed cells leave ties unspecified. Compatibility does not prove original rounding, reconstruction or physical timing; incompatibility rejects only this stated hypothesis.

printed_time_support.interpretation: Closed sample support; no continuation or end-exclusive time inferred.
